subject: Elara Health | Post-call commitments & evidence request
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Teresa Lopez <teresa@elarahealth.com>, Doug Miller <doug.miller@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Redwood inference demo & next steps

Hi Teresa / Doug —

Thanks again for taking time to walk through your use case earlier today. Quick write-up from my side so we have a single source of truth and clear next steps.

Summary of pain points you shared:
- Production variability: ML infra shows large latency spikes at peak times impacting clinician search and triage flows.
- Cost surprise: current per-token and inference unit bills spike when batch sizes fluctuate; need predictable unit economics for 3M+ queries/mo.
- Compliance: patient-data residency and audit logs are required; on-prem or VPC deployment options preferred for pilot.

Primary goals we heard:
1) Pilot: prove integration with embeddings-based semantic search in the triage UI (goal: p50 < 150ms, p99 < 1s for 512-token queries).
2) Economics: target unit cost reduction ~30% vs current baseline while maintaining quality.
3) Security: SOC2 evidence and a private deployment option for PHI workloads.

Proposed engagement milestones (draft):
- Week 0 (by 2027-06-14): Technical kickoff (Redwood & Elara infra, API keys, sample data & prompt set). Owner: Rachel (Redwood), Mark (Elara CTO).
- Week 2 (by 2027-06-28): Ingest & integration proof-of-concept with embeddings endpoint + dashboard. Owner: Monica (Redwood CS), Elara eng.
- Week 4 (by 2027-07-12): Performance tuning & cost profile; initial quality check against sample prompts. Owner: Monica / Rachel.
- Week 8 (by 2027-08-09): Pilot review & decision checkpoint (go/no-go for production rollout). Owner: Teresa / Procurement.

Action items I can own now:
- Attach a first-pass Mutual Action spreadsheet (Elara_MAP_v1.xlsx) with milestones and owners.
- Send SOC2 summary and a lightweight evidence pack for your security team (SOC2-summary.pdf).
- Draft SOW and preliminary pricing bands for expected pilot usage (SOW-draft.docx).

Questions for you to confirm:
1) Can you confirm the internal decision-maker list and procurement timeline?
2) Approximate pilot query volume (monthly) so we can size reserved capacity / pricing bands.
3) Any contractual must-haves (e.g., specific DPA clauses, data deletion windows)?

I attached the MAP and SOC2 summary to this thread. If that looks good I can schedule the technical kickoff for the week of June 14 — let me know which days work best for Mark and your infra lead.

Thanks —

Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189

Attachments: Elara_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOC2-summary.pdf (summary, 3 pages)

From: Teresa Lopez <teresa@elarahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Doug Miller <doug.miller@elarahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2027 16:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood inference demo & next steps

Thanks Rachel — this is helpful and aligns with what we discussed. A few clarifications from our side:

Stakeholders you should expect:
- Mark Chen (CTO) — overall technical approval
- Laura James (Head of Security & Compliance) — SOC2 & data residency questions
- Doug Miller (Procurement) — contract / SOW review
- Product: me (Teresa) — pilot success criteria owner

Timeline notes:
- We aim to start the pilot the week of June 14. Procurement asks that the SOW land with them by May 30 for internal review. Final purchasing decision targeted the week of Sept 1.

Security/procurement asks now:
- Please send SOC2 attestation and a short evidence pack for our compliance team (Laura).
- Data residency: we need confirmation that PHI can be processed within a US region and that audit logs are retained 1 year.
- Procurement: Doug asked for standard terms to be surfaced; he will circulate a redline if any.

Pilot sizing: we expect roughly 1.5–3M queries/month for the initial pilot (varies by clinician usage).

Thanks —

Teresa Lopez
Head of Product, Search & Insights | Elara Health
teresa@elarahealth.com

---

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Teresa Lopez <teresa@elarahealth.com>, Doug Miller <doug.miller@elarahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 23 May 2027 09:10:37 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Redwood inference demo & next steps

Great — thanks for the clarity, Teresa. A few quick responses and a tightened milestone plan below.

On compliance: attached SOC2-summary.pdf includes the scope, last audit date, and a one-page evidence checklist Laura can use. We can also provide KMS integration options for customer-managed keys and on-prem adapters where required. Audit logs retention: we can confirm 1-year retention for the pilot; we will surface retention policy language in the DPA.

On sizing: thanks for the 1.5–3M queries/month estimate. For quoting I will size two bands: 1.5M and 3M. Monica, can you prepare estimated reserved capacity and a short ops plan for that range?

Revised milestone plan (dates adjusted to reflect procurement review):
- 2027-06-14: Technical kickoff (owners: Rachel, Mark)
- 2027-06-21: Integration checklist completed (owners: Monica, Elara eng)
- 2027-07-05: Pilot live (embeddings + search integration)
- 2027-07-26: Cost/perf tuning; initial quality sign-off
- 2027-09-01: Procurement & executive decision

Attachments I added to this thread: SOC2-summary.pdf, SOW-draft.docx (first draft). I also uploaded the MAP to the link in related_links — please use that for live edits.

Next steps (what I'll do this week):
- Finalize SOW and send to Doug by 2027-05-28 to give procurement time to review before May 30.
- Monica will size reserved capacity/ops runbook.
- I'll schedule the technical kickoff — proposed window June 14–16; please confirm Mark's availability.

On the contract, we usually accept standard DPA language and can accept limited redlines; we'll want to see Doug's redline early.

Thanks again — talk soon.

—Rachel

- Pricing/discount guardrails: Rachel, when you send the SOW, can you include two commercial bands (1.5M / 3M) and show committed vs. burst pricing? I want to make sure any discounts are within our standard ACE approval limits.
- Monica: please draft a short ops/onboarding checklist we can include in the SOW (key rotation, key management, monitoring hooks).

Rachel — can you also confirm expected pilot average tokens per query (rough ballpark) so we can estimate token-based billing?

Thanks —
